title: The Father of Shmuel bar Rav Yitzchak
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Eruvin 97a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.97a.2), and in [Zevachim 111b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.111b.12-14), where Rava said: “Now that the father of Shmuel bar Yitzchak has taught…”

In the Jerusalem Talmud, [Rosh Hashanah 1:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Rosh_Hashanah.1.4.3) and [Challah 1:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Challah.1.1.23), the circumstances of his death are related: he fasted for two days as Yom Kippur because of uncertainty about the date; his intestine burst, and he died. Hyman says that the book Vaad Chachamim, 9b, erred in this matter by attributing it to the father of Shmuel.[^1]

notes.text: Both Bavli passages give the fuller name Shmuel bar Rav Yitzchak. The two Jerusalem Talmud accounts likewise name his father. Rav Chisda cautions against taking on the two-day fast out of calendar uncertainty.
